name: Aoyama Shouko
source:
Shoko is a student teacher at the school, although she looks just like a plain student. Overly timid and self-conscious, she's not at ease around anyone. In order to please others, she ends up doing whatever she's told.

[From [url=http://www.ign.com/faqs/2006/sensei-2-walkthrough-adult-title-733648]Ben Woodhouse's Sensei 2 Walkthrough[/url]]
